notes.public: The author asserts $\widehat\Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\widehat\Sigma_i^+=\varnothing$, followed by the written “i.e” relation $\Sigma_{\alpha_0}\cap\Sigma_i=\varnothing$. The argument writes $E_i\subset X\setminus\widehat\Sigma_{\alpha_0}^+=\Sigma_{\alpha_0}^-$, with the last low index still qualified alpha0/alpha. The underlined corollary calls $V=X\setminus\bigcup_{\alpha\in K}\widehat\Sigma_\alpha^+$ unique and gives $K=\{\alpha\in I\mid\overline V\cap E_\alpha\ne\varnothing\ \mathrm{i.e.}\ E_\alpha\cap\dot V\ne\varnothing\}$. Its final line writes $X\setminus\Sigma_\alpha$.
